strict-cue-grammar.rationale: Four exact active cues have canonical silhouette ownership, static breach silhouettes remain null, and unknown or mismatched assignments fail closed.

ring-wide-inhabited-coverage.rationale: The sixteen-by-four corridor grid keeps the complete playable ring and axial band within 1,000 metres of habitation or vegetation, including boundary samples.

deterministic-bounded-activity.rationale: Seeded cue phases and explicit presentation time reproduce matrices and colors exactly while bounded time changes animate without altering authored items.

placement-authority.rationale: Activity retains authored positions and dimensions, respects slope and exclusions, reads terrain without mutation, and preserves synchronous production world authority.

fixed-topology-low-readability.rationale: Tapered landmarks, canopy color, transit trunks, and unlit ambient detail remain readable at 1280x720 Low through four buckets and the accepted instance and triangle envelope.

accessibility-lifecycle.rationale: Live reduced motion freezes actual matrix and color signatures, listener disposal is explicit, and sustained production updates preserve GPU resources and context.

regression-review.rationale: Focused unit and browser lanes, LS-12 and LS-13 production regressions, full repository check, protected core match, and independent review pass.

polish.summary: Further non-color differentiation between transit and ambient micro-detail may be considered during later primitive-art refinement.
polish.reopenTrigger: Do not reopen LS-14 unless a cue loses Low readability, deterministic activity, reduced-motion behavior, fixed topology, or ring-wide coverage.
